summary.text: John Kavanagh, a Republican, represents District 3 in the Arizona State Senate, which he joined on January 9, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He is the Senate majority leader, a post he has held since June 27, 2025.
Kavanagh was born in New York City, served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1971 to 1976, and holds a bachelor's degree from New York University and a doctorate from Rutgers University.
His career experience includes working as a college professor and police detective sergeant.
